name: multi_device_scene
description: Add one or more members -- to a new group/scene, or an existing one -- in a single call, given a list of member devices with controller/responder roles. This is the only way to add a member, including a single one; use `group_scene_op` only to remove a member or update an existing member's link behavior. A device can only be a controller in ONE group/scene at a time -- if a requested controller is already a controller elsewhere, this call rejects up front with an error naming that existing group/scene, before touching anything. That is a real, permanent constraint, not a transient/server error: how to respond to it (never retry with the same or a guessed different address, never silently remove the device from its existing group/scene, tell the customer which group/scene it already controls and ask how to proceed) is in GROUPS AND SCENES, Crosslink conflicts -- follow that.

group_address.description: The existing group/scene's real id to add these members to, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE -- never guessed. Omit to create a new group/scene.

group_name.description: Name for the new group/scene when group_address is omitted. Omit to let NuCore assign one automatically.

devices.description: Non-empty list of member devices to add, each with its role in the group/scene.

link_address.description: The member device's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE -- never guessed.

role.description: Whether this device triggers the group/scene (controller) or reacts to it (responder).

name.description: Optional display name for this member within the group/scene.
